# Feature: Toggle switch — sanity check

<!-- Generated by the project-manager tool from pm.yml. Do not edit by hand; the store is the source of truth. -->

## Goal

Sanity-check candidate mechanic #22 (Toggle switch) from Switches and Doors before it is used in real levels. Effect: each press swaps two doors. Unique: one press inverts two doors and the state persists. Useful: binary room configuration you set and walk away from. Source status in the candidate file is 'trial'.

## User Story

**As a** player

**I want** each press swaps two doors.

**So that** binary room configuration you set and walk away from.

## High-Level Use Case

The player meets Toggle switch for the first time in its teaching room (mech-22-toggle-switch-room). Teaching moment: First room: a toggle switch between two doors, one open and one closed. A player who presses it a second time to be sure swaps the doors back and finds their exit closed again, which teaches that the state persists and that pressing is itself the thing to count. The sanity check plays that room, exercises every rule below, and records a replayable session.

## Player-Facing Behavior

- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Stepping on it swaps its two linked doors, open becomes closed and closed becomes open, and the state persists after you leave
- Given the teaching room, when the player acts, then: Pressing again swaps them back

## Edge Cases & Rules

- Movement/state stays deterministic: state advances only through the pure step function with recorded t_ms; a recorded session replays to the same end state.
- Restart (R / restart) restores the room to its initial state, including this mechanic.

## UI / Feedback

- The player sees Toggle switch's effect happen on its tile(s) exactly as the rules above describe; no hidden state.
- Any counter, inventory or HUD impact follows the rules above; if a rule needs a counter it is shown while it matters (see Open Questions).
- Failure in the teaching room returns the player to the room start / checkpoint for an immediate retry.

## Assets & Level Data Needed

- Level JSON: new Test Level mech-22-toggle-switch-room (rows + legend) implementing the teaching moment above.
- Sprites/defs: reuse existing tiles where the mechanic reuses an existing tile; add a new sprite/tile def only if this mechanic introduces a new tile (confirm in the implement task).
- Source: plans/level-design/candidate-mechanics/switches-and-doors.yml mechanic #22.
